description: This Swift source file defines the MotionService class, which provides asynchronous methods to retrieve motion activity and pedometer data using Apple's CoreMotion framework. It implements the MotionServicing protocol and handles permission checks, data querying, and data transformation for motion activities and steps/distance counts.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A final class implementing motion data retrieval methods conforming to the MotionServicing protocol, utilizing CoreMotion framework to fetch activity and pedometer data asynchronously.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified time range, converts raw data into OpenClawMotionActivityPayload.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Fetches pedometer data within a specified time range, including steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended, returning an OpenClawPedometerPayload.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Helper method to convert ISO8601 string date parameters into Date objects, defaulting to start of the current day or current date if nil.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum to a string label.
